name: ═══════════════ CAMERA MANAGEMENT (DOMAIN 611) ═══════════════
info:
## Camera Management Flow

**Flow Number:** 611

### Purpose
Handles Tapo camera ONVIF events and health monitoring.

### Responsibilities
- Process MQTT motion/person events
- Send Telegram notifications for detection
- Handle /camera_status and /camera_help commands
- Track camera online/offline status

### Notifications
- Real-time detection alerts
- Camera health alerts (online/offline)

name: Process Camera Event
Process Camera Health
Handle /camera_status
Handle /camera_help
func:
const helpText = `📷 *CAMERA SYSTEM HELP*\n\n` +
                 `This service monitors your Tapo cameras via ONVIF for real-time motion events.\n\n` +
                 `*Commands:*\n` +
                 `📊 \`/camera_status\` - Show health and last detection\n` +
                 `❓ \`/camera_help\` - This help message\n\n` +
                 `*Detection Icons:*\n` +
                 `👤 - Person detected\n` +
                 `🏃 - General motion detected\n\n` +
                 `*Status Icons:*\n` +
                 `🟢 - Camera is online and monitoring\n` +
                 `🔴 - Camera is offline or unreachable`;

msg.payload = {
    chatId: msg.telegram.chatId,
    type: 'message',
    content: helpText,
    parse_mode: 'Markdown'
};

return msg;
